answer: The garden debit happens at intake, trellis totals the burned amount, and oasis anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 23 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. A farm as a result burns the burn once for every alias on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. Each copy needs 6 hours of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
